name: tether-browser
description: Browser MCP server and extension: Claude Code, Codex and any MCP agent use the tabs you share in Chrome or Firefox, signed in as you.

scripts.test: node scripts/build-ext.js && node test/e2e.mjs && node test/e2e.mjs --fallback && node test/features.mjs && node test/features.mjs --fallback
scripts.pack:firefox: node scripts/build-ext.js && npx --yes web-ext@8 build -s dist/firefox -a dist --overwrite-dest -n tether-firefox-{version}.xpi
scripts.sign:firefox: node scripts/build-ext.js && npx --yes web-ext@8 sign -s dist/firefox -a dist --channel unlisted

author: Udaysinh Sapate (https://udaysinh.me)
